description.en:
The ID of the dedicated cluster.

> Specify at least one of the **VpcId** and **DedicatedHostGroupId** parameters.
The page number of the list. The default value is 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50。默认值为50。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The maximum value is 50. The default value is 50.
The region ID of the vSwitch.
The ID of the resource group to which the vSwitch belongs.

description.zh:
交换机所属专有网络ID。

> **VpcId**和**DedicatedHostGroupId**参数至少输入一个。
description.en:
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the vSwitch belongs.

> Specify at least one of the **VpcId** and **DedicatedHostGroupId** parameters.
The zone ID of the vSwitch.
